discovery_articles.title: Lazareto de Menorca in Es Castell, Spain
discovery_articles.snippet: Hidden on a small island in the middle of Mahón Harbour, the Lazareto of Menorca is one of Europe's largest and best-preserved maritime quarantine stations. Built during the 19th century, it was designed to isolate ships, passengers, and cargo arriving from ports affected by deadly diseases such as plague, cholera, and yellow fever. Long before antibiotics and vaccines, quarantine was one of the few effective ways to stop epidemics from spreading across Europe.

Its smaller scale is part of the charm.

news.title: Rachel Roddy’s recipe for figs with raspberry cream and cat tongue biscuits | A kitchen in Rome
news.snippet: Combine these simple Italian baked treats with chilled fruit and thick cream for a playful summer pudding In his exquisite The French Menu Cookbook , Richard Olney has clear ideas and strong opinions about everything, including dessert. He believed that rich desserts should follow only the simplest of meals, whereas with most menus (meaning all the sophisticated menus in his book), something light, airy and playful is best. His suggestions read like a summer fruit poem: peach melba, apple mousse with peaches, apricot fritters dusted with icing sugar, strawberries in sweetened orange juice, strawberries in beaujolais, strawberry mousse with raspberry puree, iced cherries and fresh almonds.
news.blurb: Rachel Roddy makes a quietly compelling case for why figs, raspberry cream, and crisp little cat tongue biscuits are all summer really needs.

recipe.title: cucumber salad with sesame and rice vinegar
recipe.snippet: It is an error that needs correcting that in the near-20 years of plugging recipes into this url, only a few truly star cucumbers — and highly unrepresentative too, given that we are probably eating some format of cucumbers at half the nights of the week with dinner, and snacking on them throughout all of the other days. Crunchy, cold, hydrating, inexpensive, and taking well to any region of ingredients you wish to apply, I don’t need to sell you on their appeal, especially as we slog through our n th heat wave of the summer. I suspect that the lack of cucumber representation in the archives has more to do with the fact that little about cucumber salads brings out my inner obsessive recipe finetuner; usually I’m just throwing it together.
recipe.blurb: A beautifully simple cucumber salad dressed in sesame and rice vinegar — the kind of cool, effortless thing that earns its place at every warm-weather table.
